caption: The drawing depicts a horizontal decorative border strip. The strip is filled with floral and botanical motifs. On the left side, there are two beige and tan colored roses with green leaves. Toward the center and right, there is a symmetrical design consisting of a central flower-like shape with radiating, pointed beige and tan elements, surrounded by small green leaves and stems. The background of the strip is predominantly dark green, with the foliage elements in various shades of green. The bottom edge of the strip features a narrow golden-brown band with a scalloped or beaded pattern above a lighter tan line. The border strip is set against a plain, off-white background.
title: Wallpaper
